title: Batman & Robin
about: Batman, Robin and Batgirl take on Mr Freeze and Poison Ivy, who plan to freeze Gotham.
cue: Serve dessert when Mr Freeze freezes the charity auction.
faces: Master Bruce, I made soup. Eat it while it's hot, the city is turning cold.
Cooked prawns on crushed ice with a mayo dip. All right everyone, chill.
Kiss me and I'll tell you. Cos cups with pea shoots and feta.
Crisp pastry cases of crab, lemon mayo and chives, avocado and roe, for the botanical gala.
Never leave the cave without the Bat credit card.
Chicken, carrot and noodle soup. Alfred cancels the pizzas.
Thawing out after Freeze's Observatory gun.
Allow me to break the ice. Vanilla and mint on a chocolate base.
Lemonade ice cubes and blue pea tea in a slush. Stay cool, Birdboy.
What killed the dinosaurs? The Ice Age.
A tray charge applies to every order. Prices subject to change. Ivy's one kiss, for luck. Barbara Wilson becoming Batgirl. Form RS 497. Images: TMDB.

All right everyone, chillHow to make it500g cooked prawns1 bag crushed ice4 tbsp mayonnaise2 tbsp tomato sauce1 tsp lemon juice1 dash hot saucePile crushed ice onto a platter and arrange the prawns on top.Mix the mayonnaise with tomato sauce, lemon and hot sauce.Serve in a small bowl in the middle. Everybody chill.Poison Ivy garden salad cupsKiss me and I'll tell you. Cos cups with pea shoots and fetaHow to make it2 baby cos lettuces1 punnet pea shoots1 Lebanese cucumber, sliced1/4 cup mint leaves1 tbsp lemon juice1 tsp honey1 tbsp olive oil100g fetaSeparate the cos into small cups.Toss the pea shoots, cucumber and mint with lemon juice, honey and olive oil.Spoon into the cups and crumble feta over the top.Diamond auction crab tartletsCrisp pastry cases of crab, lemon mayo and chives, avocado and roe, for the botanical galaHow to make itNot on tonight's cookCrisp little pastry cases filled with crab, lemon mayo and chives, topped with avocado and a sparkle of salmon roe.Cut 24 rounds from 2 sheets of shortcrust pastry, press into mini muffin tins, prick and bake at 190°C for 12 minutes until golden, then cool.Mix 250g drained crab meat with 3 tbsp mayo, the zest and a squeeze of 1 lemon, 2 tbsp chopped chives and salt.Dice 1 avocado with lemon juice.Fill each case with crab, a little avocado and a few salmon roe.Cheddar and chive sconesNever leave the cave without the Bat credit card.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.From the kitchenAlfred's chicken soupChicken, carrot and noodle soup. Alfred cancels the pizzasHow to make it600g chicken thigh fillets2 carrots, sliced2 celery sticks, sliced1 brown onion, halved2 L water150g egg noodles3 tbsp chopped parsley1 lemonPut the chicken, carrots, celery and onion in a pot with the water.Simmer until the chicken is cooked.Shred the chicken back into the pot.Add the noodles and cook.Finish with parsley and a squeeze of lemon.Gotham thaw chipotle beef chilliThawing out after Freeze's Observatory gunHow to make itNot on tonight's cookBeef chuck slow cooked with kidney beans, chipotle, cumin and tomato until thick and smoky, with sour cream, cheddar and warm cornbread.Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches.Soften 2 onions and 3 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp cumin, 2 chopped chipotles in adobo, 2 cans crushed tomatoes, 500ml beef stock and the beef.Cover and simmer 2.5 hours, adding 2 drained cans kidney beans for the last 30 minutes.Mix 200g cornmeal, 150g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 eggs, 300ml milk and 80g melted butter and bake at 200°C for 22 minutes.Something sweetFrozen Gotham ice cream cakeAllow me to break the ice. Vanilla and mint on a chocolate baseHow to make it250g chocolate biscuits80g butter, melted1 L vanilla ice cream1 L mint ice cream4 meringue nests, crushedCrush the biscuits with the butter and press into a tin.Soften the ice creams and layer over the base.Freeze overnight.Top with crushed meringue like fresh snow just before slicing.DrinksMr Freeze blue lemonade slushieLemonade ice cubes and blue pea tea in a slush. Stay cool, BirdboyHow to make it1 tbsp dried butterfly pea flowers250ml boiling water3 tbsp sugar750ml lemonade2 cups ice4 lime wedgesSteep the pea flowers in the boiling water, strain, stir in the sugar and chill.Pour the lemonade into ice cube trays.Freeze the lemonade cubes overnight.Blend the lemonade cubes with the blue tea and ice until slushy and serve with lime wedges.Rubber lips Pimm's cupWhat killed the dinosaurs?
